answer_en: For admission at KIPM, we accept JEE Mains and CUET-UG scores. We also offer admission based on your Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Admission ke liye kaunse entrance exam dene padenge?
answer_hi: KIPM mein admission ke liye hum JEE Mains aur CUET-UG accept karte hain. Aap apne 12th ke marks (Merit) par bhi admission le sakte hain.

question_en: How can I get admission to B.Tech?
answer_en: You can secure admission in B.Tech through three ways: JEE Mains rank, CUET-UG score, or your Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: B.Tech mein admission kaise milega?
answer_hi: B.Tech mein admission lene ke teen tarike hain: JEE Mains rank, CUET-UG score, ya phir aapki 12th ki Merit.

question_en: Can I get admission without JEE Mains?
answer_en: Yes, if you haven't taken JEE Mains, you can apply using your CUET-UG score or directly through Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Kya bina JEE Mains ke admission ho sakta hai?
answer_hi: Haan, agar aapne JEE Mains nahi diya hai, toh aap CUET-UG score ya seedhe 12th ke marks (Merit) se admission le sakte hain.

question_en: Is CUET-UG valid for KIPM admission?
answer_en: Yes, CUET-UG is valid. KIPM accepts students via CUET-UG, JEE Mains, and also Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Kya KIPM mein CUET-UG valid hai?
answer_hi: Haan, CUET-UG bilkul valid hai. KIPM mein admission CUET-UG, JEE Mains aur 12th Merit teeno ke through hota hai.

question_en: What is the admission criteria if I have low rank in entrance?
answer_en: If your entrance rank is low, you can still apply for admission based on your Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Agar entrance mein kam rank aayi toh admission kaise hoga?
answer_hi: Agar entrance mein rank kam hai, toh aap apne 12th ke marks (Merit) ke basis par bhi admission ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

question_en: Do I need to give an entrance exam for admission?
answer_en: It is recommended to give JEE Mains or CUET-UG, but it is not compulsory as we also accept Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Kya admission ke liye entrance exam dena zaroori hai?
answer_hi: JEE Mains ya CUET-UG dena accha hai, par zaroori nahi hai kyunki hum 12th Merit ke basis par bhi admission lete hain.

question_en: What documents or scores are needed for counseling?
answer_en: You will need your scorecard for JEE Mains or CUET-UG. If applying via direct mode, your Class 12th Marksheet (Merit) is required.
question_hi: Counseling ke liye kaunse score ya documents chahiye?
answer_hi: Aapko JEE Mains ya CUET-UG ka scorecard chahiye hoga. Agar direct apply kar rahe hain toh 12th ki Marksheet (Merit) lagegi.

question_en: Is Class 12th percentage considered for admission?
answer_en: Yes, your Class 12th percentage (Merit) is a valid criteria for admission, alongside JEE Mains and CUET-UG.
question_hi: Kya 12th ke percentage par admission milta hai?
answer_hi: Haan, 12th ke percentage (Merit) par admission milta hai, iske alawa JEE Mains aur CUET-UG bhi option hain.

question_en: List the exams for engineering admission.
answer_en:
1. JEE Mains
2. CUET-UG
3. Class 12th Merit (Direct Admission)
question_hi: Engineering admission ke liye kaunse exams hain?
answer_hi:
1. JEE Mains
2. CUET-UG
3. 12th Merit (Seedha Admission)

question_en: I want to take admission, suggest me the exams.
answer_en: You should appear for JEE Mains or CUET-UG. If you miss these, you can rely on your Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Mujhe admission lena hai, kaunse exam dun?
answer_hi: Aapko JEE Mains ya CUET-UG dena chahiye. Agar wo miss ho jaye, toh 12th Merit par admission le sakte hain.

question_en: Who is eligible for B.Tech Lateral Entry?
question_hi: B.Tech Lateral Entry ke liye kaun eligible hai?
answer_en: Candidates who have completed a 3-year Diploma in Engineering or a B.Sc. degree (with Mathematics in 12th) are eligible to join B.Tech directly in the 2nd year.
answer_hi: Jin students ne 3-saal ka Engineering Diploma ya B.Sc. (12th mein Maths ke saath) kiya hai, wo directly B.Tech ke 2nd year mein admission le sakte hain.

question_en: Is CUET UG required for Lateral Entry?
question_hi: Kya Lateral Entry ke liye CUET UG dena zaroori hai?
answer_en: Yes, many top universities like AKTU, MMMUT, and HBTU now take admissions through CUET UG. You usually need to appear for Mathematics, a Domain subject (like Computer Science/Engineering Graphics), and the General Test.
answer_hi: Haan, kaafi badi universities jaise AKTU aur MMMUT ab CUET UG ke through admission leti hain. Aapko Mathematics, ek Domain subject, aur General Test ka paper dena hota hai.

question_en: Can I get admission based on my Diploma marks (Merit-based)?
question_hi: Kya Diploma ke marks par merit-based admission mil sakta hai?
answer_en: Some private colleges and specific state counseling processes offer admission based on your Diploma/B.Sc. percentage. Usually, a minimum of 45-50% aggregate is required.
answer_hi: Kuch private colleges aur state councils aapke Diploma ya B.Sc. ke percentage (Merit) par admission dete hain. Iske liye kam se kam 45-50% marks hona zaroori hai.

question_en: What are the extra requirements for B.Sc. graduates?
question_hi: B.Sc. graduates ke liye extra requirements kya hain?
answer_en: B.Sc. students must have had Mathematics in Class 12th. Additionally, they may need to clear 1st-year engineering subjects like Engineering Graphics and Mechanics along with their 2nd-year curriculum.
answer_hi: B.Sc. students ke paas 12th mein Maths hona chahiye. Saath hi, unhe 2nd year ke saath-saath 1st year ke kuch subjects (jaise Engineering Graphics) bhi clear karne padte hain.

question_en: Do I need a Domicile certificate for Lateral Entry?
question_hi: Kya Lateral Entry ke liye Domicile certificate chahiye?
answer_en: If you are applying for state government colleges (like through UPTAC in UP), a Domicile certificate is mandatory to claim seat reservations and fee benefits.
answer_hi: Agar aap state government colleges mein apply kar rahe hain, toh reservation aur fees mein chhoot ke liye Domicile (Niwas Praman Patra) zaroori hota hai.

question_en: What documents are required for admission to any department?
answer_en: For admission to all departments, you need to submit: 10th and 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate (Father's annual income below ₹2 Lakh), Domicile Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Transfer Certificate (TC), Character Certificate (CC), and 4 passport-size photos.
question_hi: Kisi bhi department mein admission ke liye kaunse documents chahiye?
answer_hi: Sabhi departments mein admission ke liye aapko ye documents jama karne honge: 10th aur 12th ki Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate (Father ki salana income ₹2 Lakh se kam), Domicile Certificate, Caste Certificate (agar lagu ho), Transfer Certificate (TC), Character Certificate (CC), aur 4 passport-size photos.

question_en: List the documents needed for college admission.
answer_en: Required documents: 1. 10th & 12th Marksheets 2. Aadhaar Card 3. Father's Income Certificate (below ₹2 Lakh) 4. Domicile Certificate 5. Caste Certificate (if applicable) 6. TC & CC 7. 4 Photos of the student.
question_hi: College admission ke liye zaroori documents ki list bataiye.
answer_hi: Zaroori documents hain: 1. 10th aur 12th ki Marksheets 2. Aadhaar Card 3. Father ka Income Certificate (₹2 Lakh se kam) 4. Domicile Certificate 5. Caste Certificate (agar applicable ho) 6. TC aur CC 7. Student ki 4 photos.

question_en: Do I need an income certificate for admission?
answer_en: Yes, an Income Certificate showing your father's annual income is below ₹2 Lakh is required, along with 10th/12th marksheets, Aadhaar, Domicile, Caste certificate (if applicable), TC, CC, and 4 photos.
question_hi: Kya admission ke liye income certificate zaroori hai?
answer_hi: Haan, Father ka Income Certificate (jisme income ₹2 Lakh se kam ho) zaroori hai. Iske saath 10th/12th marksheets, Aadhaar, Domicile, Caste certificate (agar hai), TC, CC, aur 4 photos bhi chahiye.

question_en: What is the checklist for admission paperwork?
answer_en: Please ensure you have: 10th & 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate (< 2 Lakh), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, Character Certificate, and 4 student photos.
question_hi: Admission paperwork ki checklist kya hai?
answer_hi: Kripya ye check karein: 10th aur 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate (2 Lakh se kam), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, Character Certificate, aur 4 student photos.

question_en: I want to take admission, what should I bring?
answer_en: Bring your 10th and 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, valid Income Certificate (Father's income < 2 Lakh), Domicile & Caste Certificates, TC, CC, and 4 recent photos.
question_hi: Mujhe admission lena hai, main kya lekar aaun?
answer_hi: Apni 10th aur 12th ki Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, valid Income Certificate (Father ki income 2 Lakh se kam), Domicile aur Caste Certificates, TC, CC, aur 4 recent photos lekar aayein.

question_en: Is there a gap year affidavit required for admission?
answer_en: Yes, if you have a gap between your 12th/Graduation and current admission, you must submit a Gap Year Affidavit along with other required documents like 10th/12th Marksheets, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), and TC/CC (Character Certificate).
question_hi: Kya admission ke liye Gap Year Affidavit dena padega?
answer_hi: Haan, agar aapke 12th/Graduation aur abhi ke admission ke beech gap hai, toh aapko Gap Year Affidavit dena hoga. Iske saath baaki documents jaise 10th/12th Marksheet, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), aur TC/CC bhi lagenge.

question_en: What is the dress code or uniform policy?
answer_en: Yes, KIPM has a strict uniform policy to maintain discipline. Students must wear the prescribed college uniform during classes and official events.
question_hi: Kya college mein uniform pehanna zaroori hai?
answer_hi: Haan, KIPM mein discipline banaye rakhne ke liye strict uniform policy hai. Students ko classes aur official events ke dauran college uniform pehanna zaroori hai.

question_en: Why should I join KIPM College?
answer_en: You should join KIPM for its excellent placement record, experienced faculty, NBA accreditation in engineering branches, green campus, and focus on holistic student development through clubs like Maverick.
question_hi: Mujhe KIPM College kyun join karna chahiye?
answer_hi: Aapko KIPM join karna chahiye kyunki yahan ka placement record behtareen hai, faculty experienced hai, engineering branches mein NBA accreditation hai, aur yahan students ke overall development par focus kiya jata hai.

question_en: Is attendance compulsory for students?
answer_en: Yes, as per university (AKTU/BTE) norms, a minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory to appear for semester examinations.
question_hi: Kya students ke liye attendance zaroori hai?
answer_hi: Haan, university (AKTU/BTE) ke niyamon ke anusar, semester exam dene ke liye kam se kam 75% attendance hona anivarya hai.

question_en: How is the internet connectivity on campus?
answer_en: The entire KIPM campus, including hostels and academic blocks, is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed internet to support digital learning.
question_hi: Campus mein internet connectivity kaisi hai?
answer_hi: Pura KIPM campus, jisme hostels aur academic blocks shamil hain, high-speed Wi-Fi se juda hua hai taaki digital learning mein madad mil sake.

question_en: Can I get admission in the second year directly?
answer_en: Yes, Lateral Entry is available for Diploma holders and B.Sc graduates into the 2nd year of B.Tech. You need to submit your Diploma/B.Sc documents along with the standard admission paperwork.
question_hi: Kya main seedhe second year mein admission le sakta hoon?
answer_hi: Haan, Diploma holders aur B.Sc graduates ke liye B.Tech ke 2nd year mein Lateral Entry available hai. Aapko apne Diploma/B.Sc ke documents aur admission paperwork jama karne honge.

question_en: Is the campus ragging-free?
answer_en: Absolutely. KIPM follows a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging. We have an Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad to ensure a safe environment for freshers.
question_hi: Kya campus mein ragging hoti hai?
answer_hi: Bilkul nahi. KIPM ragging ke khilaf zero-tolerance policy apnata hai. Freshers ki suraksha ke liye humare paas Anti-Ragging Committee aur Squad hai.

question_en: Do you provide education loan assistance?
answer_en: Yes, KIPM has a dedicated cell to assist students in getting education loans. We provide all necessary fee structure documents and have tie-ups with banks like PNB.
question_hi: Kya aap education loan lene mein madad karte hain?
answer_hi: Haan, KIPM mein students ko education loan dilwane ke liye ek dedicated cell hai. Hum zaroori documents provide karte hain aur PNB jaise banks ke saath hamara tie-up hai.

question_en: Are there separate hostels for freshers?
answer_en: Yes, to ensure safety and comfort, freshers are often accommodated in separate blocks or floors within the hostel premises.
question_hi: Kya freshers ke liye alag hostel hai?
answer_hi: Haan, suraksha aur suvidha ke liye, freshers ko aksar hostel premises ke andar alag blocks ya floors par rakha jata hai.

question_en: What documents are needed for Lateral Entry admission?
answer_en: For Lateral Entry, you need: Diploma/B.Sc Marksheets, 10th & 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, CC, and 4 photos.
question_hi: Lateral Entry admission ke liye kaunse documents chahiye?
answer_hi: Lateral Entry ke liye chahiye: Diploma/B.Sc Marksheets, 10th aur 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, CC, aur 4 photos.

question_en: Does the college have a power backup?
answer_en: Yes, KIPM has 24x7 power backup with heavy-duty generators to ensure uninterrupted classes, labs, and hostel facilities.
question_hi: Kya college mein power backup hai?
answer_hi: Haan, KIPM mein 24x7 power backup hai heavy-duty generators ke saath, taaki classes, labs aur hostel mein bijli na jaye.

question_en: How are the personality development programs?
answer_en: We conduct regular Soft Skills training, Group Discussions (GD), and Personal Interviews (PI) preparation classes to make students industry-ready.
question_hi: Personality development programs kaise hain?
answer_hi: Hum regular Soft Skills training, Group Discussions (GD), aur Personal Interviews (PI) ki tayari karwate hain taaki students job ke liye taiyar ho sakein.

question_en: Can I visit the campus before taking admission?
answer_en: Yes, we encourage students and parents to visit the KIPM campus in GIDA, Gorakhpur to see the infrastructure, labs, and facilities personally.
question_hi: Kya admission lene se pehle main campus visit kar sakta hoon?
answer_hi: Haan, hum students aur parents ko encourage karte hain ki wo GIDA, Gorakhpur mein KIPM campus visit karein aur khud infrastructure aur labs dekhein.

question_en: Is there a gym facility in the college?
answer_en: Yes, there are well-equipped gymnasiums available in the hostels for students to maintain their physical fitness.
question_hi: Kya college mein gym ki suvidha hai?
answer_hi: Haan, students ki fitness ke liye hostels mein well-equipped gymnasiums available hain.

question_en: What if I don't have a Domicile Certificate right now?
answer_en: You can submit an undertaking or apply for it immediately. However, for final verification, the Domicile Certificate is a required document along with your Marksheets and Aadhaar.
question_hi: Agar mere paas abhi Domicile Certificate nahi hai toh kya karun?
answer_hi: Aap undertaking de sakte hain ya turant apply kar sakte hain. Lekin final verification ke liye Domicile Certificate, Marksheets aur Aadhaar ke saath zaroori hai.

question_en: Does KIPM offer M.Tech courses?
answer_en: Yes, KIPM offers M.Tech in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, and Electronics & Communication.
question_hi: Kya KIPM mein M.Tech courses hote hain?
answer_hi: Haan, KIPM mein Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, aur Electronics & Communication mein M.Tech courses offer kiye jate hain.

question_en: How far is the college from Gorakhpur Railway Station?
answer_en: The college is well-connected by road and is located in GIDA, which is a manageable distance from Gorakhpur Junction. College buses and autos are available.
question_hi: Gorakhpur Railway Station se college kitni door hai?
answer_hi: College sadak marg se achi tarah juda hai aur GIDA mein sthit hai. Gorakhpur Junction se yahan pahunchne ke liye college bus aur auto mil jate hain.

question_en: Are there project opportunities for engineering students?
answer_en: Yes, students work on live projects and capstone projects under the guidance of expert faculty in well-equipped labs.
question_hi: Kya engineering students ke liye project opportunities hain?
answer_hi: Haan, students expert faculty ki dekh-rekh mein well-equipped labs mein live projects aur capstone projects par kaam karte hain.

question_en: I want to take admission in Pharmacy, suggested exams?
answer_en: For Pharmacy (B.Pharm), you should appear for CUET-UG or UPSEE. For D.Pharm, JEECUP is the preferred exam. Direct admission on 12th Merit is also possible.
question_hi: Mujhe Pharmacy mein admission lena hai, kaunsa exam dun?
answer_hi: Pharmacy (B.Pharm) ke liye aapko CUET-UG ya UPSEE dena chahiye. D.Pharm ke liye JEECUP behtar hai. 12th Merit par direct admission bhi ho sakta hai.

question_en: Documents for MBA admission?
answer_en: For MBA, submit: Graduation Marksheets, 10th & 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, CC, and 4 photos.
question_hi: MBA admission ke liye documents?
answer_hi: MBA ke liye jama karein: Graduation Marksheets, 10th aur 12th Marksheets, Aadhaar, Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakh), Domicile, Caste Certificate, TC, CC, aur 4 photos.

question_en: What are the types of library facilities available at KIPM College?
answer_en: KIPM College provides three types of library facilities: Central Library, General Library, and a Digital Library.
question_hi: KIPM College mein kaunse types ki library facilities hain?
answer_hi: KIPM College mein teen tarah ki library facilities hain: Central Library, General Library, aur Digital Library.

question_en: How many books are available and what are the issue rules?
answer_en: The library has 26,000+ books. A student can issue 3 books at a time for a duration of 14 days.
question_hi: Library mein kitni books hain aur book issue karne ke rules kya hain?
answer_hi: Library mein 26,000 se zyada books hain. Ek student ek baar mein 3 books 14 dino ke liye issue karwa sakta hai.

question_en: What are the working days and hours of the library?
answer_en: The library operates 24*7 from Monday to Saturday to support students' academic needs.
question_hi: Library ke khulne ka samay aur din kya hain?
answer_hi: Students ki padhai ke liye library Monday se Saturday tak 24*7 kaam karti hai.

question_en: Does the college provide digital resources?
answer_en: Yes, the Digital Library provides access to e-books and online journals to help with research and projects.
question_hi: Kya college digital resources provide karta hai?
answer_hi: Haan, Digital Library ke zariye aap e-books aur online journals access kar sakte hain jo research mein madad karte hain.

question_en: Is there a Book Bank facility available?
answer_en: Yes, KIPM offers a Book Bank facility where students can issue a set of textbooks for the entire semester.
question_hi: Kya college mein Book Bank ki suvidha hai?
answer_hi: Haan, KIPM mein Book Bank ki suvidha hai jahan se students pure semester ke liye textbooks ka set issue karwa sakte hain.

question_en: What happens if I return a book late?
answer_en: If a book is not returned within the due date (14 days), a nominal late fine is charged per day.
question_hi: Agar maine book late wapas ki toh kya hoga?
answer_hi: Agar aapne 14 din ke andar book wapas nahi ki, toh aapko har din ke hisaab se late fine dena padega.

question_en: Can I reissue or renew a book?
answer_en: Yes, books can be reissued or renewed for another 14 days, provided no other student has reserved them.
question_hi: Kya main book ko dobara issue ya renew karwa sakta hoon?
answer_hi: Haan, agar kisi aur student ne book reserve nahi ki hai, toh aap usse agle 14 dino ke liye renew karwa sakte hain.

question_en: Is the library air-conditioned?
answer_en: Yes, the Central Library and the Reading Room are fully air-conditioned to provide a comfortable study environment.
question_hi: Kya library mein AC laga hai?
answer_hi: Haan, Central Library aur Reading Room fully air-conditioned hain taaki padhai ke liye araamdayak mahaul mile.

question_en: Are there journals and magazines available?
answer_en: The library subscribes to various National and International Journals, magazines, and newspapers for current affairs and research.
question_hi: Kya library mein journals aur magazines milti hain?
answer_hi: Library mein research aur current affairs ke liye National aur International Journals, magazines aur newspapers available hain.

question_en: What do I need to enter the library?
answer_en: A valid Student ID Card is mandatory for entry into the library and for issuing books.
question_hi: Library mein jaane ke liye kya chahiye?
answer_hi: Library mein entry lene aur books issue karwane ke liye valid Student ID Card hona anivarya hai.

question_en: What happens if I lose a library book?
answer_en: If a book is lost, the student must either replace it with a new copy or pay the current market price of the book along with a fine.
question_hi: Agar library ki book kho jaye toh kya karna hoga?
answer_hi: Agar book kho jati hai, toh student ko ya toh nayi book deni padegi ya fir book ki current keemat aur fine bharna padega.

question_en: Is there a reference section in the library?
answer_en: Yes, there is a dedicated Reference Section containing encyclopedias, dictionaries, and project reports which are for reading only and cannot be issued.
question_hi: Kya library mein reference section hai?
answer_hi: Haan, wahan ek Reference Section hai jisme encyclopedias aur project reports hain, inhe sirf wahan padha ja sakta hai, ghar le jane ke liye issue nahi kiya ja sakta.

question_en: Are computers available in the library?
answer_en: Yes, the Digital Library section is equipped with modern computers and high-speed internet for students to access online study materials.
question_hi: Kya library mein computers available hain?
answer_hi: Haan, Digital Library section mein computers aur high-speed internet hai taaki students online study material access kar sakein.

question_en: Can I bring my personal books to the library?
answer_en: Yes, you can bring personal notes and books to study in the Reading Room, but they must be declared at the entry gate.
question_hi: Kya main apni personal books library mein la sakta hoon?
answer_hi: Haan, aap Reading Room mein padhne ke liye apne notes aur books la sakte hain, lekin entry gate par batana zaroori hai.

question_en: Is there a seating facility for students?
answer_en: The library has a large seating capacity with comfortable furniture, ensuring a quiet and peaceful environment for concentration.
question_hi: Kya students ke baithne ki jagah hai?
answer_hi: Library mein baithne ki kaafi jagah (seating capacity) hai aur furniture comfortable hai taaki shanti se padhai ho sake.

question_en: I want to take admission, suggest me the exams.
answer_en: You should appear for JEE Mains or CUET-UG for B.Tech and B.Pharm. For Diploma courses, JEECUP is required. If you miss these, you can apply for Direct Admission based on your Class 12th Merit.
question_hi: Mujhe admission lena hai, kaunse exam dun?
answer_hi: Aapko B.Tech aur B.Pharm ke liye JEE Mains ya CUET-UG dena chahiye. Diploma ke liye JEECUP zaruri hai. Agar ye miss ho jaye, toh aap 12th Merit ke aadhar par Direct Admission le sakte hain.

question_en: How can I apply for Pharmacy (B.Pharm/D.Pharm)?
answer_en: You can apply via CUET-UG (for B.Pharm) or JEECUP (for D.Pharm) counselling. Direct admission is also available for remaining seats through the college website.
question_hi: Pharmacy (B.Pharm/D.Pharm) ke liye apply kaise karein?
answer_hi: Aap CUET-UG (B.Pharm ke liye) ya JEECUP (D.Pharm ke liye) counselling ke dwara apply kar sakte hain. Bachi hui seats ke liye college ki website se direct admission bhi mil sakta hai.

question_en: Is there a lateral entry option for Diploma holders?
answer_en: Yes, Diploma holders can take direct admission into the 2nd year of B.Tech through the UPTAC lateral entry counselling process.
question_hi: Kya Diploma holders ke liye lateral entry ka option hai?
answer_hi: Haan, Diploma holders UPTAC lateral entry counselling ke madhyam se B.Tech ke second year mein direct admission le sakte hain.
